- Marketplace: https://lobehub.com/skills
- Manifest: [manifest.json](./manifest.json)
- Local copies live under `/skills` with per-skill `SOURCE.md`
- Research notes: [`docs/skills/research-lobehub-superpowers-2026-08-20.md`](../../docs/skills/research-lobehub-superpowers-2026-08-20.md)
